title: Install your bound kits before the IA 3.6.0 release
summary: The next release of the `ia` plugin moves to IA 3.6.0, whose door runs a kit the repository binds only when the repository's own `.ia/distributions.lock.json` installs it. Run `kit.mjs bind <kit> --install --apply` now for each kit you bind (the session start names any that are missing); a repository that installs on this release keeps working at the next. The bundled `ia-authoring` 0.1.3 and `ia-kb` 0.9.3 are patch re-cuts whose guidance teaches that route; `ia-method` stays at 0.7.2, because its archive is unchanged and only its README text changed.
